title: Final Output Equals Final State
statement: Let $$ be a Boolean state transition function that takes a state and two input bits, and let $s$ be an initial Boolean state. For any nonempty finite sequence of pairs of Boolean inputs, if each output bit is computed by applying $$ to the current state and the next input pair, then the last output bit equals the state obtained after processing the entire sequence.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean state transition function of three Boolean arguments
A nonempty list of pairs of Boolean inputs
